note: The tagged HopCountWithinMaximumIsApplied and HopCountAboveMaximumDrawsLoopDetected correctly distinguish Label Mapping hop counts 4 and 5 at configured maximum 4, including callback data/suppression and exact advisory reply. But full RFC5036 section 3.4.4.1 covers received Label Request as well as Label Mapping. Session.processMessages groups MsgTypeLabelRequest among unhandled message types, without parsing/checking Hop Count. Both tagged tests send Mapping only, so they cannot detect this uncovered receive behavior. Renewed producer-halt records prove reachability, not whole-row enforcement.
